review.title: Progress summaries
review.description: Review the monthly summaries the AI drafted for the parents of your homeroom class. Nothing reaches the parents until you approve and send it.
review.noHomeroom: You are not the homeroom teacher of a classroom this year, so there are no summaries to review.
review.error: The summaries could not be loaded.
review.empty: There are no summaries for this month yet. The drafts are written at the start of each month; you can also ask for one below.
review.sendBody: The parents of {{count}} student(s) will be notified and can read the summary. A sent summary can no longer be changed.
review.nothingToSend: Approve at least one summary first.

missing.title: Students without a summary
missing.hint: Students with no grades, attendance, assignments or notes that month get no summary. Ask for one when data was added later.

edit.title: Summary of {{name}}
edit.label: Text for the parents
edit.help: Keep it simple and kind. Describe what happened; do not guess causes or label the child.
edit.saved: Text saved. Approve it to include it in the next send.

notes.title: Teacher notes
notes.description: Short notes about your students. They help the AI write the monthly summaries and the report-card texts; parents never see a note itself.
notes.noClasses: You do not work in any classroom this year.
notes.prompt: Choose a classroom and a student to see and add notes.
notes.label: New note
notes.placeholder: For example: helped a classmate with fractions this week.
notes.error: The notes could not be loaded.

mine.title: Progress summaries
mine.description: The monthly letters from the school about how your child is doing.
mine.empty: No summary has been sent yet.
mine.error: The summaries could not be loaded.

progress.no_data: There is no data of this student in that month to write a summary from.
progress.already_sent: This summary was already sent to the parents and can no longer change.
progress.not_homeroom: Only the homeroom teacher of the classroom works with its summaries.
progress.future_month: A summary cannot be written for a month that has not started.

ai.daily_limit: You have used your AI calls of today. Try again tomorrow.
ai.budget_exhausted: The AI budget of this month is used up. The AI features are off until next month.
ai.invalid_output: The AI did not give a usable text. Try again.
ai.provider_failed: The AI service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
ai.not_configured: The AI service is not set up.

notes.future_date: A note cannot be about a day that has not come yet.
